WITH l AS ( SELECT i.id, o.supplier_id, COALESCE(i.line_due_date, o.delivery_date) AS due_date, o.status, i.qty - i.offset_in_qty AS need FROM pur_order_item i JOIN pur_order o ON o.id = i.purchase_order_id WHERE o.status IN ('APPROVED', 'RUNNING', 'DONE', 'CLOSED') AND COALESCE(i.line_due_date, o.delivery_date) BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to}
), r AS ( SELECT di.source_item_id AS line_id, d.doc_date, SUM(CASE WHEN d.doc_type = 'PURCHASE_RETURN' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END * COALESCE(di.purchase_qty, di.qty / NULLIF(di.conversion_factor, 0), di.qty)) AS qty, bool_or(d.doc_type = 'PURCHASE_IN') AS arrived FROM inv_doc d JOIN inv_doc_item di ON di.doc_id = d.id WHERE d.doc_type IN ('PURCHASE_IN', 'PURCHASE_RETURN') AND d.status = 'APPROVED' AND d.source_type = 'PURCHASE_ORDER' AND di.source_item_id IN (SELECT id FROM l) GROUP BY di.source_item_id, d.doc_date ), c AS ( SELECT line_id, doc_date, SUM(qty) OVER (PARTITION BY line_id ORDER BY doc_date) AS total FROM r ) SELECT l.id AS line_id, l.supplier_id, l.due_date, l.status, l.need, (SELECT MIN(c.doc_date) FROM c WHERE c.line_id = l.id AND c.total >= l.need AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM c c2 WHERE c2.line_id = l.id AND c2.doc_date > c.doc_date AND c2.total < l.need)) AS full_date, (SELECT MAX(r.doc_date) FROM r WHERE r.line_id = l.id AND r.arrived) AS last_date FROM l

WITH p AS ( SELECT p.id, p.factory_id, p.due_date, p.status, p.total_qty FROM prd_order p WHERE p.status IN ('APPROVED', 'RUNNING', 'DONE', 'CLOSED') AND p.due_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to}
), r AS ( SELECT r.prd_order_id, r.receipt_date, SUM(ri.qty - ri.defect_qty) AS good FROM prd_receipt r JOIN prd_receipt_item ri ON ri.receipt_id = r.id WHERE r.status <> 'VOIDED' AND r.prd_order_id IN (SELECT id FROM p) GROUP BY r.prd_order_id, r.receipt_date ), c AS ( SELECT prd_order_id, receipt_date, SUM(good) OVER (PARTITION BY prd_order_id ORDER BY receipt_date) AS total FROM r ) SELECT p.id AS prd_order_id, p.factory_id, p.due_date, p.status, p.total_qty AS qty, (SELECT MIN(c.receipt_date) FROM c WHERE c.prd_order_id = p.id AND c.total >= p.total_qty) AS full_date, (SELECT MAX(r.receipt_date) FROM r WHERE r.prd_order_id = p.id) AS last_date, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.good), 0) FROM r WHERE r.prd_order_id = p.id AND r.receipt_date <= p.due_date) AS good_by_due FROM p

SELECT p.factory_id, SUM(ri.qty) AS qty, SUM(ri.defect_qty) AS defect FROM prd_receipt r JOIN prd_receipt_item ri ON ri.receipt_id = r.id JOIN prd_order p ON p.id = r.prd_order_id WHERE r.status <> 'VOIDED' AND r.receipt_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to}
GROUP BY p.factory_id

SELECT p.product_line, s.category_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS order_count, SUM(GREATEST(pi.qty - (pi.returned_qty - pi.defect_qty), 0)) AS wip_qty, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.expect_date, p.due_date) < #{today} THEN GREATEST(pi.qty - (pi.returned_qty - pi.defect_qty), 0) ELSE 0 END) AS late_qty FROM prd_order p JOIN prd_order_item pi ON pi.prd_order_id = p.id JOIN sty_style s ON s.id = p.style_id WHERE p.status IN ('DRAFT', 'PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'RUNNING')
GROUP BY p.product_line, s.category_id

SELECT p.product_line, s.category_id, SUM(p.total_qty) AS qty FROM prd_order p JOIN sty_style s ON s.id = p.style_id WHERE p.status <> 'VOIDED' AND p.order_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to}
GROUP BY p.product_line, s.category_id

SELECT p.product_line, s.category_id, SUM(ri.qty - ri.defect_qty) AS qty FROM prd_receipt r JOIN prd_receipt_item ri ON ri.receipt_id = r.id JOIN prd_order p ON p.id = r.prd_order_id JOIN sty_style s ON s.id = p.style_id WHERE r.status <> 'VOIDED' AND r.receipt_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to}
GROUP BY p.product_line, s.category_id

WITH s AS ( SELECT st.warehouse_id, st.material_sku_id, SUM(st.qty) AS qty FROM inv_stock st JOIN bas_warehouse w ON w.id = st.warehouse_id AND w.type = 'MATERIAL'
st.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}
GROUP BY st.warehouse_id, st.material_sku_id HAVING SUM(st.qty) > 0 ), m AS ( SELECT l.warehouse_id, l.material_sku_id, MAX(l.biz_date) AS last_date FROM inv_stock_log l JOIN s ON s.warehouse_id = l.warehouse_id AND s.material_sku_id = l.material_sku_id WHERE l.count_id IS NULL AND l.reversal_of_log_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inv_stock_log rv WHERE rv.reversal_of_log_id = l.id) GROUP BY l.warehouse_id, l.material_sku_id ) SELECT s.warehouse_id, w.name AS warehouse_name, s.material_sku_id AS sku_id, s.qty, m.last_date,
(SELECT l2.unit_price FROM inv_stock_log l2 WHERE l2.material_sku_id = s.material_sku_id AND l2.unit_price IS NOT NULL AND l2.change_qty > 0 AND l2.reversal_of_log_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inv_stock_log rv WHERE rv.reversal_of_log_id = l2.id) ORDER BY l2.id DESC LIMIT 1)
NULL::numeric AS unit_price FROM s JOIN bas_warehouse w ON w.id = s.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN m ON m.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id AND m.material_sku_id = s.material_sku_id WHERE m.last_date IS NULL OR m.last_date <= #{before} ORDER BY m.last_date NULLS FIRST, s.material_sku_id
SELECT order_id, tech_pack_id, SUM(qty) AS qty FROM ord_order_item WHERE order_id IN #{id} GROUP BY order_id, tech_pack_id
